# gleam.fits

**Source**: MWATelescope/mwa_hyperdrive test suite (https://github.com/MWATelescope/mwa_hyperdrive), `test_files/gleam.fits` (byte-identical), generated by `test_files/gen_fits_srclists.py` in the same repo

**License**: MPL-2.0

**Description**: Synthetic sky-model source list in the "Gleam" FITS format that hyperdrive reads (the column layout used by the GLEAM-X pipeline; see `mdbook/src/defs/source_list_fits.md` upstream). It does not contain real GLEAM survey sources: the 4 rows are test sources named `point-pl`, `point-cpl`, `gauss-pl` and `gauss-cpl`, with `Name` (9A), `RAJ2000`, `DEJ2000` (deg), `S_200` (Jy at 200 MHz), `alpha`, `beta` (curvature), and Gaussian `a`, `b` (arcsec) and `pa` (deg). The table has no `TUNIT` keywords. Used by hyperdrive to test FITS source-list parsing.

**Instrument/Mission**: Murchison Widefield Array (MWA), GLEAM-X source-list format

## HDU Structure

| HDU | Type     | Dimensions        | EXTNAME | Description                           |
|-----|----------|-------------------|---------|---------------------------------------|
| 0   | Primary  | (empty)           |         | Minimal primary header                |
| 1   | BINTABLE | 9 cols x 4 rows   |         | Source catalog (RA, Dec, flux, spectral index, etc.) |

## FITS Features Exercised

- Empty primary HDU
- Binary table with one string column (`9A`) and eight double (`D`) columns
- Astronomical catalog format

**File size**: 8,640 bytes (8.4 KB)
